LESSON 30 / ADDITIONAL INTERVIEW CONCEPT
Link targets, rel and download

Anchor attributes control navigation. target="_blank" opens a new browsing context; rel="noopener"
prevents access to the opener. download is a download hint, subject to browser rules.
target="_blank" අලුත් tab එකෙකෙ open කෙරන්න පුළුවන්. rel="noopener" opener එකෙට access වීම නවත්වනවා. download attribute එකෙ download කෙරන්න browser එකෙට hint එකෙකේ Jදෙනවා.
An invoice page links to a PDF and an external help site.
Invoice page · New tab · Help site · Help site ↗ · Download invoice · invoice.pdf

Read the diagram: One link opens another browsing context. The second suggests saving a file.
Inform users when a link opens a new tab or downloads a file.
Help (new tab) Download invoice (PDF)
Expected result: A help tab opens; the same-origin invoice link requests a download.
Answer: It prevents a new browsing context from accessing window.opener.
